name: Mini-sota Monday Qualifier 2025
information: ### There is no 3x3 at this competition and it is held on a *Monday evening* ##### This competition is **not recommended** for new competitors. It will only host One-Handed, 4x4 Blindfolded, and 6x6 solving. [Click here for other upcoming Minnesota competitions.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?search=minnesota) ##### ____________________________________ Only 1 guest per competitor is allowed to enter the room to ensure we have enough space. Additional guests may relax in the library.
